title: Code and data for: Phage-antibiotic synergy in ESKAPE pathogens - a scoping review of antibiotic-partner selection
description:
Extraction dataset (442 antibiotic-level observations from 166 studies; 419 from 157 in v1.0.0), derived data tables, complete screening audit trail for 4,402 records, and analysis code that reproduces every number, table and statistic in the accompanying scoping review. The repository includes scripts/validate_results.py, which independently recomputes and asserts every reported statistic (172 checks) without relying on stored derived tables.

Article abstracts and full texts retrieved during screening are third-party copyrighted material and are not redistributed; the screening audit file records the bibliographic identifier, relevance score and scoring rationale for every screened record, which is sufficient to reproduce the screening decisions and re-retrieve any record.

v1.1.0 adds a post hoc sensitivity screen that removed environmental isolation-source terms from the triage off-target penalty, adding 9 eligible studies and 23 antibiotic-level observations, and corrects the clustering estimator from a variance ratio (eta-squared) to a one-way ANOVA ICC(1). Both the 157-study and 166-study versions are validated by scripts in the repository.
